Its eyes gently open and close when you pet it, it laughs when tossed playfully and it cries if it falls.
Hug it and it responds affectionately, which adds comfort to the classic teddy bear shape.

cautions: Conversation and guidance may be mostly in English; check the manual for supported languages and how it connects.
Because the seller price is over USD 150, Korean customs duty may apply; the page notes it when it does.
